desc: Home to many of the world's top-ranked universities, with merit scholarships at many of them and wide acceptance of the Duolingo English Test. OPT gives 12 months of work after graduation, up to 36 on a STEM degree.
ብዙ የዓለም ቀዳሚ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች መኖሪያ ናት፤ ብዙዎቹ የብቃት ስኮላርሺፕ ይሰጣሉ፤ የDuolingo ፈተናንም በሰፊው ይቀበላሉ። OPT ከምረቃ በኋላ 12 ወር ስራ ይሰጣል፤ በSTEM ዲግሪ እስከ 36።

Yuunivarsiitiiwwan addunyaa sadarkaa olaanaa irra jiran hedduun kan argaman; baay'een isaanii iskoolarshippii dandeettii ni kennu, qormaata Duolingo ni fudhatu. OPT eebba booda ji'a 12 hojii kenna, digrii STEM hanga 36.
መበቆል ብዙሓት ቀዳሞት ዩኒቨርሲቲታት ዓለም እያ፤ ብዙሓት ስኮላርሺፕ ብቕዓት ይህቡ፣ ፈተና Duolingo ድማ ይቕበሉ። OPT ድሕሪ ምምራቕ 12 ወርሒ ስራሕ ይህብ፣ ብSTEM ዲግሪ ክሳብ 36።

Make your social media accounts public and list those from the last five years

Barattoonni Itoophiyaa ammas viizaa F-1 iyyachuu danda'u. Wabiin viizaa 2026 viizaa tuuristii fi daldalaaf malee viizaa barataaf miti.
ተማሃሮ ኢትዮጵያ ሕጂ'ውን ንቪዛ F-1 ክምልከቱ ይኽእሉ። ዋሕስ ቪዛ 2026 ንቪዛ ቱሪስትን ንግድን እምበር ንቪዛ ተማሃሮ ኣይኮነን።
Consular officers review your public social media from the last five years.
የቆንስላ መኮንኖች ያለፉትን አምስት ዓመታት ይፋዊ ማህበራዊ ሚዲያዎን ይመለከታሉ።
Qondaaltonni qonsilaa miidiyaa hawaasaa kee kan waggoota shan darban ni ilaalu.
ሰራሕተኛታት ቆንስላ ናይ ዝሓለፈ ሓሙሽተ ዓመት ህዝባዊ ማሕበራዊ ሚድያኻ ይርእዩ።
Many universities accept the Duolingo English Test, taken from home.

desc: Canada lets students work 24 hours a week off campus and offers a Post-Graduation Work Permit of up to three years. Study permits are capped, and from 1 September 2026 you must show at least CAD 23,448 a year for living costs, plus tuition and travel.
ካናዳ ተማሪዎች ከካምፓስ ውጭ በሳምንት 24 ሰዓት እንዲሰሩ ትፈቅዳለች፤ እስከ ሶስት ዓመት የተመራቂ የስራ ፈቃድ ትሰጣለች። የጥናት ፈቃዶች የተገደቡ ናቸው፤ ከመስከረም 1 ቀን 2026 (እ.ኤ.አ.) ጀምሮ ከትምህርት ክፍያና ከጉዞ በተጨማሪ ለኑሮ በዓመት ቢያንስ CAD 23,448 ማሳየት አለብዎት።

Kanaadaan barattoonni kaampaasii alatti torbanitti sa'a 24 akka hojjetan ni hayyamti, hayyama hojii eebba booda hanga waggaa sadii kenniti. Hayyamni barnootaa daangeffameera; 1 Fulbaana 2026 irraa eegalee baasii jireenyaaf waggaatti yoo xiqqaate CAD 23,448, kaffaltii barnootaa fi imalaa dabalatee agarsiisuu qabda.

Iddoon Mastercard Foundation Scholars guutummaatti kaffalama garuu dorgommii guddaa qaba.

Sagantaa Ingiliffaa irratti illee, Afaan Jarmanii xiqqoon hojii yeroo muraasaatiif baay'ee gargaara.
ብእንግሊዝኛ እንተተማሃርካ'ውን ቁሩብ ጀርመንኛ ንናይ ትርፊ ግዜ ስራሕ ኣዝዩ ይሕግዝ።

desc: Italian public university fees are capped by law and scaled to family income (the ISEE system), so many international students pay close to the €900 floor. There are 500+ English-taught degrees, mostly at master's level.
የጣሊያን የመንግስት ዩኒቨርሲቲ ክፍያዎች በህግ የተገደቡና ከቤተሰብ ገቢ ጋር የሚመጣጠኑ ናቸው (ISEE)፤ ስለዚህ ብዙ ዓለም አቀፍ ተማሪዎች ወደ €900 የቀረበ ይከፍላሉ። ከ500 በላይ በእንግሊዝኛ የሚሰጡ ዲግሪዎች አሉ፤ አብዛኞቹ በሁለተኛ ዲግሪ ደረጃ።

Kaffaltiin yuunivarsiitii mootummaa Xaaliyaan seeraan daangeffamee galii maatii irratti hundaa'a (ISEE); kanaaf barattoonni idil-addunyaa hedduun €900 naannoo kaffalu. Digriiwwan Ingiliffaan kennaman 500 ol jiru, baay'een sadarkaa digrii lammaffaa.
ክፍሊት መንግስታዊ ዩኒቨርሲቲታት ጣልያን ብሕጊ ዝተደረተን ምስ ኣታዊ ስድራ ዝመጣጠንን እዩ (ISEE)፤ ስለዚ ብዙሓት ኣህጉራውያን ተማሃሮ ኣስታት €900 ይኸፍሉ። ልዕሊ 500 ብእንግሊዝኛ ዝወሃቡ ዲግሪታት ኣለዉ፣ መብዛሕትኦም ካልኣይ ዲግሪ።

data.visa: National Type D Study Visa (Visto per Studio)
steps: Get admitted, then pre-enrol on the Universitaly portal

Arrange health insurance and proof of accommodation
Apply for the Type D visa at the Italian Embassy in Addis Ababa

tips: Fees are income-based, so two students on the same course can pay very different tuition.
ክፍያዎች በገቢ ስለሚወሰኑ በአንድ ኮርስ ያሉ ሁለት ተማሪዎች በጣም የተለያየ ሊከፍሉ ይችላሉ።
Kaffaltiin galii irratti waan hundaa'uuf, barattoonni lama koorsii tokko irratti garaagarummaa guddaa kaffaluu danda'u.
ክፍሊት ብኣታዊ ስለ ዝውሰን፣ ኣብ ሓደ ኮርስ ዘለዉ ክልተ ተማሃሮ ኣዝዩ ዝተፈላለየ ክኸፍሉ ይኽእሉ።
DSU grants can include free housing and meals worth more than the tuition.
የDSU ድጋፎች ከክፍያው በላይ ዋጋ ያለው ነጻ መኖሪያና ምግብ ሊያካትቱ ይችላሉ።
Deeggarsi DSU mana jireenyaa fi nyaata bilisaa kaffaltii caalu of keessaa qabaachuu danda'a.
ደገፍ DSU ካብ ክፍሊት ዝበለጸ ነጻ መንበሪን መግብን ከጠቓልል ይኽእል።

desc: Hungary runs Stipendium Hungaricum, one of the world's largest fully funded scholarships, covering tuition, a monthly stipend and housing at 25+ public universities. It is also a major hub for English-taught medicine.
ሃንጋሪ ከዓለም ትልልቅ ሙሉ ስኮላርሺፖች አንዱ የሆነውን ስቲፔንዲየም ሁንጋሪኩምን ታስተዳድራለች፤ በ25+ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ክፍያን፣ ወርሃዊ አበልንና መኖሪያን ይሸፍናል። በእንግሊዝኛ የሚሰጥ የህክምና ትምህርት ትልቅ ማዕከልም ናት።

Hangaariin Stipendium Hungaricum, iskoolarshippii guutuu addunyaa irratti guddaa keessaa tokko, ni geggeessiti; yuunivarsiitii 25+ keessatti kaffaltii, qarshii ji'aa fi mana jireenyaa kaffala. Akkasumas wiirtuu barnoota fayyaa Ingiliffaan kennamu guddaa dha.
ሃንጋሪ ሓደ ካብቶም ዝዓበዩ ምሉኣት ስኮላርሺፓት ዓለም ዝኾነ ስቲፐንድዩም ሁንጋሪኩም ተካይድ፤ ኣብ 25+ ዩኒቨርሲቲታት ክፍሊት፣ ወርሓዊ ኣበልን መንበሪን ይሽፍን። ብእንግሊዝኛ ዝወሃብ ትምህርቲ ሕክምና ዓቢ ማእከል እያ።

Stipendium Hungaricum iddoo kooraa biyyaatiin kenna; dafii iyyadhu.

tips: Submitting the wrong JW form is a common, avoidable visa mistake.
የተሳሳተ የJW ቅጽ ማስገባት የተለመደ የቪዛ ስህተት ነው።
Unka JW dogoggoraa galchuun dogoggora viizaa beekamaa dha.
ጌጋ ቅጥዒ JW ምቕራብ ልሙድ ጌጋ ቪዛ እዩ።
Provincial scholarships are less competitive than the national CSC.
የክልል ስኮላርሺፖች ከብሄራዊው CSC ያነሰ ውድድር አላቸው።
Iskoolarshippiin naannoo CSC biyyaalessaa caalaa dorgommii xiqqaa qaba.
ስኮላርሺፕ ኣውራጃ ካብ ሃገራዊ CSC ዝወሓደ ውድድር ኣለዎ።

desc: Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları) fully fund thousands of international students every year, including a Turkish language year. Public universities are affordable, many programs are taught in English, and Istanbul is about five and a half hours from Addis.
የቱርክ ስኮላርሺፕ (Türkiye Bursları) በየዓመቱ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዓለም አቀፍ ተማሪዎችን ሙሉ በሙሉ ይደግፋል፤ የቱርክኛ ቋንቋ ዓመትንም ያካትታል። የመንግስት ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ተመጣጣኝ ናቸው፤ ብዙ ፕሮግራሞች በእንግሊዝኛ ይሰጣሉ፤ ኢስታንቡል ከአዲስ አበባ አምስት ሰዓት ተኩል ገደማ በረራ ነው።

Yuunivarsiitiiwwan mootummaa gatii madaalawaa qabu, sagantaaleen hedduun Ingiliffaan kennamu; Istanbul Finfinnee irraa xiyyaaraan sa'a shanii fi walakkaa naannoo.
ስኮላርሺፕ ቱርኪ (Türkiye Bursları) ኣብ ዓመት ብኣሽሓት ዝቑጸሩ ኣህጉራውያን ተማሃሮ ብምሉኡ ይድግፍ፣ ናይ ቱርክኛ ቋንቋ ዓመት'ውን የጠቓልል። መንግስታዊ ዩኒቨርሲቲታት ብዋጋ ዝምጥኑ እዮም፣ ብዙሓት መደባት ብእንግሊዝኛ ይወሃቡ፣ ኢስታንቡል ካብ ኣዲስ ኣበባ ኣስታት ሓሙሽተ ሰዓትን ፍርቅን በረራ እዩ።

data.visa: Student visa, then a residence permit (ikamet)
steps: Get your admission letter or Türkiye Scholarships award
Apply for the student visa at the Turkish Embassy in Addis Ababa
Travel and register at your university
Apply for your residence permit within one month
Get your Turkish ID number and health insurance
work: Students can work part-time with a work permit. Bachelor's students usually qualify after their first year, up to 24 hours a week.
ተማሪዎች በስራ ፈቃድ የትርፍ ጊዜ ስራ መስራት ይችላሉ። የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ ተማሪዎች ብዙውን ጊዜ ከመጀመሪያው ዓመት በኋላ በሳምንት እስከ 24 ሰዓት ይፈቀድላቸዋል።
Barattoonni hayyama hojiitiin hojii yeroo muraasaa hojjechuu danda'u. Barattoonni digrii jalqabaa yeroo baay'ee waggaa jalqabaa booda, torbanitti hanga sa'a 24 hayyamamaaf.
ተማሃሮ ብፍቓድ ስራሕ ናይ ትርፊ ግዜ ስራሕ ክሰርሑ ይኽእሉ። ተማሃሮ ቀዳማይ ዲግሪ መብዛሕትኡ ድሕሪ ቀዳማይ ዓመት ኣብ ሰሙን ክሳብ 24 ሰዓት ይፍቀደሎም።
tips: Türkiye Scholarships opens once a year, usually January to February. Prepare your documents before it opens.
የቱርክ ስኮላርሺፕ በዓመት አንድ ጊዜ፣ ብዙውን ጊዜ ከጥር እስከ የካቲት ይከፈታል። ከመከፈቱ በፊት ሰነዶችዎን ያዘጋጁ።
Iskoolarshippiin Turkii waggaatti al tokko, yeroo baay'ee Amajjii hanga Guraandhalaa banama. Osoo hin banamin dura sanadoota kee qopheessi.
ስኮላርሺፕ ቱርኪ ኣብ ዓመት ሓደ ግዜ፣ መብዛሕትኡ ካብ ጥሪ ክሳብ ለካቲት ይኽፈት። ቅድሚ ምኽፋቱ ሰነዳትካ ኣዳሉ።
Many scholarship students study in Turkish after a free language year.

Barattoonni iskoolarshippii hedduun waggaa afaanii bilisaa booda Afaan Turkiitiin baratu.
ብዙሓት ተማሃሮ ስኮላርሺፕ ድሕሪ ነጻ ዓመት ቋንቋ ብቱርክኛ ይመሃሩ።

Arrange medical insurance for your whole stay

Check that your degree will be recognised in Ethiopia before you enrol.
ከመመዝገብዎ በፊት ዲግሪዎ በኢትዮጵያ እውቅና እንደሚያገኝ ያረጋግጡ።
Osoo hin galmaa'in dura digriin kee Itoophiyaatti beekamtii akka argatu mirkaneeffadhu.
ቅድሚ ምምዝጋብካ ዲግሪኻ ኣብ ኢትዮጵያ ኣፍልጦ ከም ዝረክብ ኣረጋግጽ።

data.visa: UAE Student Residence Visa (sponsored by the university)
steps: Get an offer and sponsorship letter from an accredited UAE university
The university files your entry permit
Medical fitness test within 30 days of arrival
Emirates ID biometrics and health insurance
Residence visa issued within 60 days
work: Part-time work needs a MoHRE work permit and your university's approval, often 15 to 20 hours a week in term and full-time in official breaks. After graduation, an employer-sponsored work visa.
የትርፍ ጊዜ ስራ የMoHRE የስራ ፈቃድና የዩኒቨርሲቲዎን ፈቃድ ይፈልጋል፤ ብዙውን ጊዜ በትምህርት ወቅት በሳምንት ከ15 እስከ 20 ሰዓት፣ በይፋዊ እረፍት ሙሉ ጊዜ። ከምረቃ በኋላ በአሰሪ የሚደገፍ የስራ ቪዛ።

Karaawwan baay'een kaampaasii dhuunfaa ykn damee keessa.
መብዛሕትኦም መገድታት ብብሕታውያን ወይ ጨናፍር ካምፓሳት እዮም።
A medical test is done in the UAE after arrival.
የህክምና ምርመራ ከደረሱ በኋላ በኤምሬትስ ይደረጋል።

name: France

tag: Low public fees and the Eiffel scholarship
ዝቅተኛ የመንግስት ክፍያና የኤፍል ስኮላርሺፕ
Kaffaltii mootummaa gadi aanaa fi iskoolarshippii Eiffel
ትሑት መንግስታዊ ክፍሊትን ስኮላርሺፕ ኤፍልን
desc: From 2026-27, almost all new non-EU students at public universities pay EUR 2,895 a year for a bachelor's and EUR 3,941 for a master's, still far below most English-speaking countries. Most bachelor's are in French, with many English-taught master's.

ከ2026-27 ጀምሮ በመንግስት ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ከአውሮፓ ውጭ የሚመጡ አዲስ ተማሪዎች በሙሉ ማለት ይቻላል ለመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ በዓመት EUR 2,895፣ ለሁለተኛ ዲግሪ EUR 3,941 ይከፍላሉ፤ ይህ ከብዙ እንግሊዝኛ ተናጋሪ ሀገራት በጣም ያነሰ ነው። አብዛኞቹ የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪዎች በፈረንሳይኛ ናቸው፤ በእንግሊዝኛ የሚሰጡ ብዙ ሁለተኛ ዲግሪዎች አሉ።

2026-27 irraa eegalee barattoonni haaraan Awurooppaa alaa yuunivarsiitii mootummaa keessatti digrii jalqabaaf waggaatti EUR 2,895, digrii lammaffaaf EUR 3,941 kaffalu; kunis biyyoota Ingiliffaa dubbatan baay'ee caalaa gadi aanaa dha. Digriiwwan jalqabaa baay'een Afaan Faransaayiin; digriiwwan lammaffaa Ingiliffaan kennaman hedduun jiru.

ካብ 2026-27 ጀሚሩ ኣብ መንግስታዊ ዩኒቨርሲቲታት ካብ ኤውሮጳ ወጻኢ ዝመጹ ሓደሽቲ ተማሃሮ ዳርጋ ኩሎም ንቀዳማይ ዲግሪ ኣብ ዓመት EUR 2,895፣ ንካልኣይ ዲግሪ EUR 3,941 ይኸፍሉ፤ እዚ ካብ ብዙሓት እንግሊዝኛ ዝዛረባ ሃገራት ኣዝዩ ዝተሓተ እዩ። መብዛሕትኦም ቀዳማይ ዲግሪታት ብፈረንሳይኛ እዮም፤ ብእንግሊዝኛ ዝወሃቡ ብዙሓት ካልኣይ ዲግሪታት ኣለዉ።

facts.tu: EUR 2,895/yr bachelor's · EUR 3,941/yr master's at public universities · grandes écoles cost more
facts.pr: Campus France interview, then the visa in about 2–4 weeks
facts.la: French for most bachelor's; many English-taught master's

steps: Apply through the Campus France 'Études en France' platform
Attend the Campus France interview
Show funds of at least EUR 877.50 a month (rule since 1 August 2026)
Submit your visa application for the French Embassy in Addis Ababa
Validate your VLS-TS online within three months of arrival
work: You can work up to 964 hours a year, about 20 hours a week. After a master's, you can get a one-year permit to look for work.
በዓመት እስከ 964 ሰዓት (በሳምንት 20 ሰዓት ገደማ) መስራት ይችላሉ። ከሁለተኛ ዲግሪ በኋላ ስራ ለመፈለግ የአንድ ዓመት ፈቃድ ማግኘት ይችላሉ።
Waggaatti hanga sa'a 964 (torbanitti sa'a 20 naannoo) hojjechuu dandeessa. Digrii lammaffaa booda hojii barbaaduuf hayyama waggaa tokkoo argachuu dandeessa.
ኣብ ዓመት ክሳብ 964 ሰዓት (ኣብ ሰሙን ኣስታት 20 ሰዓት) ክትሰርሕ ትኽእል። ድሕሪ ካልኣይ ዲግሪ ስራሕ ንምድላይ ናይ ሓደ ዓመት ፍቓድ ክትረክብ ትኽእል።
tips: Even basic French makes daily life and part-time work much easier.
መሰረታዊ ፈረንሳይኛ እንኳን የእለት ኑሮንና የትርፍ ጊዜ ስራን በጣም ያቀላል።
Afaan Faransaayii bu'uuraa illee jireenya guyyaa guyyaa fi hojii yeroo muraasaa baay'ee salphisa.
መሰረታዊ ፈረንሳይኛ'ውን መዓልታዊ ህይወትን ናይ ትርፊ ግዜ ስራሕን ኣዝዩ የቃልል።
Your French university applies for the Eiffel scholarship for you, so apply for admission early.
ለኤፍል ስኮላርሺፕ የሚያመለክትልዎ የፈረንሳይ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ቀድመው ለመግቢያ ያመልክቱ።
Iskoolarshippii Eiffel kan siif iyyatu yuunivarsiitii kee Faransaayiiti; kanaaf galmeef dafii iyyadhu.
ንስኮላርሺፕ ኤፍል ዘመልክተልካ ዩኒቨርሲቲኻ ኣብ ፈረንሳ እዩ፤ ስለዚ ንምእታው ቀልጢፍካ ኣመልክት።

tag: GKS: a full government scholarship with a language year
GKS፦ የቋንቋ ዓመትን ያካተተ ሙሉ የመንግስት ስኮላርሺፕ

desc: Korea combines top technology universities with the Global Korea Scholarship (GKS), which covers tuition, flights, a monthly allowance and a year of Korean. Ethiopia has its own embassy-track places every year.
ኮሪያ ከፍተኛ የቴክኖሎጂ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎችን ከGlobal Korea Scholarship (GKS) ጋር ታጣምራለች፤ GKS ክፍያን፣ በረራን፣ ወርሃዊ አበልንና የአንድ ዓመት የኮሪያኛ ትምህርትን ይሸፍናል። ኢትዮጵያ በየዓመቱ የራሷ የኤምባሲ መስመር ቦታዎች አሏት።

Kooriyaan yuunivarsiitiiwwan teknooloojii olaanoo Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) waliin walitti fiddi; GKS'n kaffaltii, xiyyaara, qarshii ji'aa fi waggaa Afaan Kooriyaa tokko ni kaffala. Itoophiyaan waggaa waggaan iddoo karaa embaasii mataa ishee qabdi.
ኮርያ ልዑላት ዩኒቨርሲቲታት ቴክኖሎጂ ምስ Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) ተጣምር፤ GKS ክፍሊት፣ በረራ፣ ወርሓዊ ኣበልን ሓደ ዓመት ኮርይኛን ይሽፍን። ኢትዮጵያ ዓመት ዓመት ናታ ቦታታት መስመር ኤምባሲ ኣለዋ።

facts.pr: D-2 visa usually 2–4 weeks after admission
facts.la: Korean or English; many graduate programs in English

steps: Get your admission letter or GKS placement
Notarise documents at MOFA Ethiopia, then at the Korean Embassy consular section
Show proof of funds or your scholarship letter
Apply for the D-2 visa at the Korean Embassy in Addis Ababa
Get your residence card within 90 days of arrival
work: Students need a free part-time work permit first. Hours depend on your level and Korean (TOPIK): master's and PhD students with TOPIK 4 can work up to 30 hours a week, others less. After graduating, the D-10 job-seeker visa.
ተማሪዎች መጀመሪያ ነጻ የትርፍ ጊዜ ስራ ፈቃድ ያስፈልጋቸዋል። ሰዓቱ በደረጃዎና በኮሪያኛ (TOPIK) ውጤትዎ ይወሰናል፦ TOPIK 4 ያላቸው የሁለተኛ ዲግሪና የPhD ተማሪዎች በሳምንት እስከ 30 ሰዓት፣ ሌሎች ያነሰ። ከምረቃ በኋላ የD-10 ስራ ፈላጊ ቪዛ።

Barattoonni dura hayyama hojii yeroo muraasaa bilisaa barbaadu. Sa'aatiin sadarkaa fi Afaan Kooriyaa (TOPIK) keetiin murtaa'a: barattoonni digrii lammaffaa fi PhD TOPIK 4 qaban torbanitti hanga sa'a 30, kaan xiqqaa. Eebba booda viizaa barbaacha hojii D-10.
ተማሃሮ መጀመርታ ነጻ ፍቓድ ናይ ትርፊ ግዜ ስራሕ የድልዮም። ሰዓታት ብደረጃኻን ብኮርያኛ (TOPIK) ውጽኢትካን ይውሰን፦ TOPIK 4 ዘለዎም ተማሃሮ ካልኣይ ዲግሪን PhDን ኣብ ሰሙን ክሳብ 30 ሰዓት፣ ካልኦት ውሑድ። ድሕሪ ምምራቕ ቪዛ ደላዩ ስራሕ D-10።
tips: GKS embassy-track places for Ethiopia are few, so a strong study plan matters.
ለኢትዮጵያ የGKS የኤምባሲ መስመር ቦታዎች ጥቂት ናቸው፤ ጠንካራ የትምህርት እቅድ ወሳኝ ነው።
Iddoon GKS karaa embaasii Itoophiyaaf muraasa; karoorri barnootaa cimaan murteessaa dha.
ንኢትዮጵያ ዝተመደቡ ቦታታት GKS ብመስመር ኤምባሲ ውሑዳት እዮም፤ ሓያል መደብ ትምህርቲ ወሳኒ እዩ።
Learning basic Korean early helps with daily life and part-time jobs.
መሰረታዊ ኮሪያኛ ቀድመው መማር ለእለት ኑሮና ለትርፍ ጊዜ ስራ ይረዳል።
Afaan Kooriyaa bu'uuraa dafanii barachuun jireenya guyyaa guyyaa fi hojii yeroo muraasaatiif gargaara.
መሰረታዊ ኮርይኛ ቀልጢፍካ ምምሃር ንመዓልታዊ ህይወትን ናይ ትርፊ ግዜ ስራሕን ይሕግዝ።

name: India

desc: India is one of the most affordable places to study in English, and many Ethiopians have studied there. Through the ICCR India-Africa Maitri scheme, India offers a set number of fully funded places to Ethiopians each year.
ህንድ በእንግሊዝኛ ለመማር በጣም ተመጣጣኝ ከሆኑ ሀገራት አንዷ ስትሆን ብዙ ኢትዮጵያውያን ተማሪዎች ተምረውባታል። በICCR India-Africa Maitri ፕሮግራም በኩል በየዓመቱ ለኢትዮጵያውያን የተወሰኑ ሙሉ ስኮላርሺፖችን ትሰጣለች።

Hindiin biyyoota Ingiliffaan barachuuf gatii madaalawaa qaban keessaa tokko; Itoophiyaanonni hedduun achitti baratanii jiru. Sagantaa ICCR India-Africa Maitri'tiin waggaa waggaan iddoo iskoolarshippii guutuu murtaa'aa Itoophiyaaf kenniti.
ህንዲ ብእንግሊዝኛ ንምምሃር ካብ ዝበለጸ ብዋጋ ዝምጥና ሃገራት ሓንቲ እያ፣ ብዙሓት ኢትዮጵያውያን ተማሂሮምላ። ብመደብ ICCR India-Africa Maitri ዓመት ዓመት ንኢትዮጵያውያን ውሱናት ምሉእ ስኮላርሺፓት ትህብ።
steps: Get your admission letter or ICCR award
Apply online for the Indian student visa
Submit documents to the Indian visa centre or Embassy in Addis Ababa

የመጀመሪያው ምክክር በእርግጥ ነጻ ነው? ምን ይካሄዳል?
Mari'annoon jalqabaa dhugumaan bilisaa? Maaltu keessatti raawwatama?
ቀዳማይ ምኽክር ብሓቂ ነጻ ድዩ? እንታይ ይካየድ?

Yes, it is completely free, and there is no obligation to continue with us.

You meet an advisor in our office in Addis Ababa or talk by phone. The advisor looks at your grades, your documents, your English level and your budget, and then tells you honestly:

  • which countries and universities fit you
  • which scholarships you have a real chance of winning
  • what is missing from your documents
  • a realistic timeline for your intake

Bring whatever documents you have. Photos on your phone are fine for a first meeting.

  • የሚስማሙዎት ሀገራትና ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች
  • በእውነት ሊያሸንፏቸው የሚችሉ ስኮላርሺፖች

Should I take IELTS or Duolingo?
IELTS ወይስ Duolingo ልውሰድ?
IELTS moo Duolingo fudhachuu qaba?

It depends on where you are applying.

  • IELTS is accepted by almost every university and visa office. It is the safest choice if you are not sure.
  • Duolingo English Test is taken online from home, costs less and usually gives results in about two days. Thousands of universities accept it, but not all of them, and not every visa route.

Most English-taught programs ask for IELTS 6.0 to 6.5, or about Duolingo 105 to 120. Before you book any test, we check the exact requirement of every university on your list.

Which documents do I need?
የትኞቹ ሰነዶች ያስፈልጉኛል?
Sanadoota kam na barbaachisa?
ኣየኖት ሰነዳት የድልዩኒ?

Most applications from Ethiopia need:

  • a valid passport
  • Grade 12 certificate and national exam result (for a bachelor's)
  • degree certificate and official transcripts (for a master's or PhD)
  • an English test result (IELTS, Duolingo or TOEFL)
  • a CV, a motivation letter and usually two recommendation letters
  • proof of funds or a scholarship letter, for the visa

Certificates usually need to be authenticated by the Ministry of Education and then the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and some embassies also stamp them. Start early, because authentication can take weeks. We give you a checklist made for your countries.

ውጭ ሀገር ለመማር ምን ያህል ያስወጣል?
Biyya alaatti barachuun hammam baasa?
ኣብ ወጻኢ ምምሃር ክንደይ የውጽእ?

Costs change a lot by country. Typical yearly figures:

  • Lower cost: Germany (no tuition at most public universities, but EUR 11,904 in a blocked account for living), India, Türkiye, Hungary, Russia and Malaysia.
  • Middle: Italy, France, China, South Korea and the UAE.
  • Higher: the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada and Australia.

Full scholarships such as Stipendium Hungaricum, Türkiye Scholarships, CSC, GKS and ICCR can cover tuition and living costs. Every country page shows tuition and living costs, and your free study plan compares them with your budget.

ወጪው እንደ ሀገሩ በጣም ይለያያል። የተለመዱ ዓመታዊ አሃዞች፦

  • ዝቅተኛ ወጪ፦ ጀርመን (በአብዛኞቹ የመንግስት ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ክፍያ የለም፤ ለኑሮ ግን €11,904 በብሎክድ አካውንት ያስፈልጋል)፣ ህንድ፣ ቱርክ፣ ሃንጋሪ፣ ራሺያና ማሌዢያ።
  • መካከለኛ፦ ጣሊያን፣ ፈረንሳይ፣ ቻይና፣ ደቡብ ኮሪያና የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬትስ።
  • ከፍተኛ፦ አሜሪካ፣ ዩናይትድ ኪንግደም፣ ካናዳና አውስትራሊያ።

እንደ ስቲፔንዲየም ሁንጋሪኩም፣ የቱርክ ስኮላርሺፕ፣ CSC፣ GKS እና ICCR ያሉ ሙሉ ስኮላርሺፖች ክፍያንና የኑሮ ወጪን ሊሸፍኑ ይችላሉ። እያንዳንዱ የሀገር ገጽ ክፍያንና የኑሮ ወጪን ያሳያል፤ ነጻ የጥናት እቅድዎም ከበጀትዎ ጋር ያወዳድረዋል።

Baasiin akkuma biyyaatti baay'ee garaagara. Lakkoofsota waggaa idilee:

  • Baasii gadi aanaa: Jarmanii (yuunivarsiitiiwwan mootummaa baay'ee keessatti kaffaltiin hin jiru, jireenyaaf garuu herrega cufaa keessatti €11,904), Hindii, Turkii, Hangaarii, Raashiyaa fi Maleeshiyaa.
  • Giddugaleessa: Xaaliyaan, Faransaay, Chaayinaa, Kooriyaa Kibbaa fi UAE.
  • Olaanaa: Ameerikaa, UK, Kanaadaa fi Awustiraaliyaa.

Iskoolarshippiin guutuun kan akka Stipendium Hungaricum, Iskoolarshippii Turkii, CSC, GKS fi ICCR kaffaltii fi baasii jireenyaa kaffaluu danda'u. Fuulli biyyaa hundi kaffaltii fi baasii jireenyaa agarsiisa; karoorri qo'annoo bilisaa kees baajata kee waliin walbira qaba.

ወጻኢ ከም ሃገሩ ኣዝዩ ይፈላለ። ልሙዳት ዓመታውያን ኣሃዛት፦

  • ትሑት ወጻኢ፦ ጀርመን (ኣብ መብዛሕትኦም መንግስታዊ ዩኒቨርሲቲታት ክፍሊት የለን፣ ንመነባብሮ ግን €11,904 ኣብ ብሎክድ ሕሳብ)፣ ህንዲ፣ ቱርኪ፣ ሃንጋሪ፣ ሩስያን ማሌዥያን።
  • ማእከላይ፦ ጣልያን፣ ፈረንሳ፣ ቻይና፣ ደቡብ ኮርያን ኢማራትን።
  • ልዑል፦ ኣመሪካ፣ ዓባይ ብሪጣንያ፣ ካናዳን ኣውስትራልያን።

ከም ስቲፐንድዩም ሁንጋሪኩም፣ ስኮላርሺፕ ቱርኪ፣ CSC፣ GKSን ICCRን ዝኣመሰሉ ምሉኣት ስኮላርሺፓት ክፍሊትን ወጻኢ መነባብሮን ክሽፍኑ ይኽእሉ። ነፍሲ ወከፍ ገጽ ሃገር ክፍሊትን ወጻኢ መነባብሮን የርኢ፤ ነጻ መደብ መጽናዕትኻ'ውን ምስ በጀትካ የወዳድሮ።
How long does the whole process take?
ሙሉ ሂደቱ ምን ያህል ጊዜ ይወስዳል?
Adeemsi guutuun hammam fudhata?
ምሉእ መስርሕ ክንደይ ግዜ ይወስድ?

Most students need 3 to 8 months from the first consultation to the visa. A typical path:

  • English test preparation: 2 to 8 weeks, if needed
  • Choosing universities and preparing documents: 1 to 2 weeks
  • Applications: 1 to 2 months
  • Waiting for offers and scholarship results: 1 to 4 months
  • Visa: 1 to 3 months, depending on the embassy

For scholarships, start 9 to 12 months before the intake, because many close almost a year before classes begin.

አብዛኞቹ ተማሪዎች ከመጀመሪያው ምክክር እስከ ቪዛ ድረስ ከ3 እስከ 8 ወራት ያስፈልጋቸዋል። የተለመደው መንገድ፦

  • ዩኒቨርሲቲዎችን መምረጥና ሰነዶችን ማዘጋጀት፦ ከ1 እስከ 2 ሳምንት
  • ማመልከቻዎች፦ ከ1 እስከ 2 ወር
  • የመግቢያና የስኮላርሺፕ ውጤት መጠበቅ፦ ከ1 እስከ 4 ወር
  • ቪዛ፦ እንደ ኤምባሲው ከ1 እስከ 3 ወር

ለስኮላርሺፕ ከትምህርት መጀመሪያው ከ9 እስከ 12 ወራት በፊት ይጀምሩ፤ ብዙዎቹ ትምህርት ከመጀመሩ አንድ ዓመት ገደማ ቀደም ብለው ይዘጋሉ።

  • Yuunivarsiitii filachuu fi sanadoota qopheessuu: torban 1 hanga 2

Iskoolarshippiif yeroo galmee dura ji'a 9 hanga 12 jalqabi; baay'een isaanii barnoonni osoo hin jalqabin waggaa tokko naannoo dura cufamu.

መብዛሕትኦም ተማሃሮ ካብ ቀዳማይ ምኽክር ክሳብ ቪዛ ካብ 3 ክሳብ 8 ኣዋርሕ የድልዮም። ልሙድ መገዲ፦

  • ምድላው ፈተና እንግሊዝኛ፦ እንተድልዩ ካብ 2 ክሳብ 8 ሰሙን
  • ዩኒቨርሲቲታት ምምራጽን ሰነዳት ምድላውን፦ ካብ 1 ክሳብ 2 ሰሙን
  • ምምልካት፦ ካብ 1 ክሳብ 2 ወርሒ
  • ውጽኢት ምእታውን ስኮላርሺፕን ምጽባይ፦ ካብ 1 ክሳብ 4 ወርሒ
  • ቪዛ፦ ከም ኤምባሲኡ ካብ 1 ክሳብ 3 ወርሒ

ንስኮላርሺፕ ቅድሚ ምጅማር ትምህርቲ ካብ 9 ክሳብ 12 ኣዋርሕ ጀምር፤ ብዙሓት ቅድሚ ምጅማር ትምህርቲ ሓደ ዓመት ኣቢሉ ይዕጸዉ።
Can I work while I study?
እየተማርኩ መስራት እችላለሁ?
Osoon baradhu hojjechuu nan danda'aa?
እናተማሃርኩ ክሰርሕ ይኽእል ዶ?

In most countries, yes, within limits set by your student visa:

  • United Kingdom: up to 20 hours a week during term
  • Canada: up to 24 hours a week off campus during term
  • Australia: up to 48 hours per two weeks during term
  • Germany: 140 full days or 280 half days a year
  • United States: on campus only, up to 20 hours a week
  • India: regular paid work is not allowed

Part-time work helps with living costs, but it is not enough to pay full tuition. Embassies want to see that you can pay without working. Each country page lists the rules in full.

በአብዛኞቹ ሀገራት አዎ፣ የተማሪ ቪዛዎ በሚፈቅደው ገደብ ውስጥ፦

  • ካናዳ፦ በትምህርት ወቅት ከካምፓስ ውጭ በሳምንት እስከ 24 ሰዓት
  • አውስትራሊያ፦ በትምህርት ወቅት በሁለት ሳምንት እስከ 48 ሰዓት
  • ጀርመን፦ በዓመት 140 ሙሉ ቀን ወይም 280 ግማሽ ቀን
  • አሜሪካ፦ በካምፓስ ውስጥ ብቻ፣ በሳምንት እስከ 20 ሰዓት
  • ህንድ፦ መደበኛ የሚከፈልበት ስራ አይፈቀድም

የትርፍ ጊዜ ስራ ለኑሮ ወጪ ይረዳል፤ ሙሉ የትምህርት ክፍያን ለመክፈል ግን በቂ አይደለም። ኤምባሲዎች ሳይሰሩ መክፈል እንደሚችሉ ማየት ይፈልጋሉ። እያንዳንዱ የሀገር ገጽ ደንቦቹን በሙሉ ይዘረዝራል።

Biyyoota baay'ee keessatti eeyyee, daangaa viizaan barataa kee hayyamu keessatti:

  • UK: yeroo barnootaa torbanitti hanga sa'a 20
  • Kanaadaa: yeroo barnootaa kaampaasii alatti torbanitti hanga sa'a 24
  • Awustiraaliyaa: yeroo barnootaa torban lamatti hanga sa'a 48
  • Jarmanii: waggaatti guyyaa guutuu 140 ykn walakkaa guyyaa 280
  • Ameerikaa: kaampaasii keessa qofa, torbanitti hanga sa'a 20

  • ካናዳ፦ ኣብ ግዜ ትምህርቲ ካብ ካምፓስ ወጻኢ ኣብ ሰሙን ክሳብ 24 ሰዓት
  • ኣውስትራልያ፦ ኣብ ግዜ ትምህርቲ ኣብ ክልተ ሰሙን ክሳብ 48 ሰዓት
  • ጀርመን፦ ኣብ ዓመት 140 ምሉእ መዓልቲ ወይ 280 ፍርቂ መዓልቲ
  • ኣመሪካ፦ ኣብ ካምፓስ ጥራይ፣ ኣብ ሰሙን ክሳብ 20 ሰዓት
  • ህንዲ፦ ስሩዕ ዝኽፈሎ ስራሕ ኣይፍቀድን

ናይ ትርፊ ግዜ ስራሕ ንወጻኢ መነባብሮ ይሕግዝ፤ ምሉእ ክፍሊት ትምህርቲ ንምኽፋል ግን ኣይኣክልን። ኤምባሲታት ከይሰራሕካ ክትከፍል ከም እትኽእል ክርእዩ ይደልዩ። ነፍሲ ወከፍ ገጽ ሃገር ሕግታት ብምሉኡ ይዝርዝር።
Do you guarantee admission or a visa?
መግቢያ ወይም ቪዛ ዋስትና ትሰጣላችሁ?
Galmee ykn viizaa wabii ni kennitu?
ምእታው ወይ ቪዛ ውሕስነት ትህቡ ዶ?

No, and be careful with anyone who does. Universities decide admission and embassies decide visas. No agent can promise either.

What we do promise is honest advice and a strong, complete application. Warning signs of a dishonest agent:

  • they guarantee a visa or admission
  • they offer fake bank statements, letters or certificates
  • they ask you to sign documents you do not understand

False documents can get you banned from a country for years. We never use them.

አንሰጥም፤ ዋስትና ከሚሰጥ ማንኛውም ሰው ይጠንቀቁ። መግቢያን ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች፣ ቪዛን ኤምባሲዎች ይወስናሉ። የትኛውም ወኪል ሁለቱንም ቃል ሊገባ አይችልም።

እኛ ቃል የምንገባው ሐቀኛ ምክርና ጠንካራ፣ የተሟላ ማመልከቻ ነው። የሐቀኝነት የጎደለው ወኪል ምልክቶች፦

  • ቪዛ ወይም መግቢያ ዋስትና ይሰጣሉ
  • ሐሰተኛ የባንክ መግለጫ፣ ደብዳቤ ወይም ሰርተፊኬት ያቀርባሉ
  • ያልተረዷቸውን ሰነዶች እንዲፈርሙ ይጠይቃሉ

ሐሰተኛ ሰነዶች ከአንድ ሀገር ለዓመታት እንዲታገዱ ሊያደርጉ ይችላሉ። እኛ በፍጹም አንጠቀምባቸውም።

Lakki; nama wabii kennu kamirraayyuu of eeggadhu. Galmee yuunivarsiitiiwwan, viizaa immoo embaasiiwwan murteessu. Ejansiin kamiyyuu lamaan isaanii waadaa galuu hin danda'u.

Kan nuti waadaa galluu gorsa dhugaa fi iyyannoo cimaa fi guutuu dha. Mallattoolee ejansii amanamaa hin taane:

  • viizaa ykn galmee wabii ni kennu
  • ragaa baankii, xalayaa ykn ragaa sobaa ni dhiyeessu
  • sanadoota ati hin hubanne akka mallatteessitu si gaafatu

Sanadoonni sobaa waggoota hedduuf biyya tokko irraa akka dhorkamtu si gochuu danda'u. Nuti gonkumaa itti hin fayyadamnu.

ኣይንህብን፤ ውሕስነት ካብ ዝህብ ዝኾነ ሰብ ተጠንቀቕ። ምእታው ዩኒቨርሲቲታት፣ ቪዛ ድማ ኤምባሲታት ይውስኑ። ዝኾነ ወኪል ክልቲኡ ቃል ክኣቱ ኣይክእልን።

ንሕና ቃል እንኣትዎ ሓቀኛ ምኽርን ሓያልን ምሉእን ምምልካትን እዩ። ምልክታት ዘይሓቀኛ ወኪል፦

  • ቪዛ ወይ ምእታው ውሕስነት ይህቡ
  • ሓሶት መግለጺ ባንክ፣ ደብዳቤ ወይ ሰርቲፊኬት የቕርቡ
  • ዘይተረዳእካዮም ሰነዳት ክትፍርም ይሓቱኻ

ሓሶት ሰነዳት ንዓመታት ካብ ሓንቲ ሃገር ከእግዱኻ ይኽእሉ። ንሕና ፈጺምና ኣይንጥቀመሎምን።
I was refused a visa before. Can I still apply?
ከዚህ በፊት ቪዛ ተከልክያለሁ። አሁንም ማመልከት እችላለሁ?
Kanaan dura viizaan na dhowwameera. Ammas iyyachuu nan danda'aa?
ቅድሚ ሕጂ ቪዛ ተኸልኪለ። ሕጂ'ውን ከመልክት እኽእል ዶ?

Yes, in most cases. A refusal is not a ban. What matters is fixing the reason.

  • Bring your refusal letter. It states the reason.
  • Common reasons are weak proof of funds, unclear study plans, or doubts that you will follow the visa rules.
  • We help you fix each point with stronger documents and a clearer study plan before you reapply.

You must always declare a previous refusal on a new application. Hiding it can lead to a much longer ban.

አዎ፣ በአብዛኛው። መከልከል እገዳ አይደለም። ዋናው ምክንያቱን ማስተካከል ነው።

  • የመከልከያ ደብዳቤዎን ይዘው ይምጡ። ምክንያቱን ይገልጻል።
  • የተለመዱ ምክንያቶች ደካማ የገንዘብ ማረጋገጫ፣ ግልጽ ያልሆነ የትምህርት እቅድ ወይም የቪዛ ደንቦችን ስለማክበርዎ ጥርጣሬ ናቸው።
  • እንደገና ከማመልከትዎ በፊት እያንዳንዱን ነጥብ በጠንካራ ሰነዶችና በግልጽ የትምህርት እቅድ እንዲያስተካክሉ እንረዳዎታለን።

በአዲስ ማመልከቻ ላይ የቀድሞውን መከልከል ሁልጊዜ ማሳወቅ አለብዎት። መደበቅ ረዘም ያለ እገዳ ሊያስከትል ይችላል።

Eeyyee, yeroo baay'ee. Dhowwamuun dhorkaa miti. Inni barbaachisaan sababa isaa sirreessuu dha.

  • Xalayaa dhowwamaa kee fidi. Sababa isaa ibsa.
  • Sababoonni beekamoon ragaa maallaqaa laafaa, karoora barnootaa ifa hin taane, ykn shakkii seera viizaa eeguu kee irratti jiru dha.
  • Osoo irra deebitee hin iyyatin dura qabxii tokkoon tokkoon sanadoota cimoo fi karoora barnootaa ifa ta'een akka sirreessitu si gargaarra.

Iyyannoo haaraa irratti dhowwama duraanii yeroo hunda ibsuu qabda. Dhoksuun dhorkaa dheeraa fiduu danda'a.

እወ፣ መብዛሕትኡ ግዜ። ምኽልካል እገዳ ኣይኮነን። እቲ ኣገዳሲ ምኽንያቱ ምእራም እዩ።

  • ደብዳቤ ምኽልካልካ ሒዝካ ምጻእ። ምኽንያቱ ይገልጽ።
  • ልሙዳት ምኽንያታት ድኹም መረጋገጺ ገንዘብ፣ ዘይንጹር መደብ ትምህርቲ ወይ ሕግታት ቪዛ ከም እተኽብር ጥርጣረ እዮም።
  • ደጊምካ ቅድሚ ምምልካትካ ነፍሲ ወከፍ ነጥቢ ብሓያላት ሰነዳትን ንጹር መደብ ትምህርትን ክትእርም ንሕግዘካ።

ኣብ ሓድሽ ምምልካት ቅድሚኡ ዝነበረ ምኽልካል ኩሉ ግዜ ክትገልጽ ኣለካ። ምሕባእ ዝነውሐ እገዳ ከስዕብ ይኽእል።
What if my grades are not strong?
ውጤቴ ጠንካራ ካልሆነስ?
Qabxiin koo cimaa yoo hin taane hoo?
ውጽኢተይ ሓያል እንተዘይኮይኑኸ?

You still have real options. We tell you honestly what is realistic, then find the best route:

  • Foundation or pathway programs prepare you for a degree when your Grade 12 result is below the direct entry level.
  • Countries with more open entry, such as Hungary, Türkiye, Malaysia, Russia and India, accept a wider range of grades.
  • A strong English score and a clear motivation letter can balance a lower GPA.
  • For a master's, work experience counts, and some scholarships such as DAAD EPOS require it.

አሁንም እውነተኛ አማራጮች አሉዎት። ተጨባጩን በሐቀኝነት እንነግርዎታለን፤ ከዚያም ምርጡን መንገድ እንፈልጋለን፦

  • የፋውንዴሽን ወይም የመሸጋገሪያ ፕሮግራሞች የ12ኛ ክፍል ውጤትዎ ለቀጥታ መግቢያ ዝቅ ሲል ለዲግሪ ያዘጋጁዎታል።
  • መግቢያቸው ክፍት የሆኑ ሀገራት እንደ ሃንጋሪ፣ ቱርክ፣ ማሌዢያ፣ ራሺያና ህንድ ሰፊ የውጤት መጠን ይቀበላሉ።
  • ጠንካራ የእንግሊዝኛ ውጤት እና ግልጽ የፍላጎት ደብዳቤ ዝቅተኛ GPAን ሊያካክሱ ይችላሉ።
  • ለሁለተኛ ዲግሪ የስራ ልምድ ይቆጠራል፤ እንደ DAAD EPOS ያሉ አንዳንድ ስኮላርሺፖች ይፈልጉታል።

Ammas filannoowwan dhugaa qabda. Waan dhugaa ta'e haqaan sitti himna, achiis karaa filatamaa barbaanna:

  • Sagantaaleen bu'uuraa ykn ce'umsaa yeroo bu'aan kutaa 12 kee galmee kallattiitiif gadi ta'u digriif si qopheessu.
  • Biyyoonni galmee banaa qaban, kan akka Hangaarii, Turkii, Maleeshiyaa, Raashiyaa fi Hindii, qabxii bal'aa fudhatu.
  • Qabxiin Ingiliffaa cimaan fi xalayaan kaka'umsaa ifa ta'e GPA gadi aanaa madaaluu danda'u.
  • Digrii lammaffaaf muuxannoon hojii ni lakkaa'ama; iskoolarshippiin tokko tokko kan akka DAAD EPOS ni barbaadu.

ሕጂ'ውን ሓቀኛ ኣማራጺታት ኣለዉኻ። ዝከኣል ብሓቂ ንነግረካ፣ ድሕሪኡ ዝበለጸ መገዲ ንደሊ፦

  • መደባት ፋውንዴሽን ወይ መሰጋገሪ ውጽኢት 12 ክፍልካ ንቐጥታ ምእታው ትሑት ክኸውን ከሎ ንዲግሪ የዳልዉኻ።
  • ምእታው ዝኽፈታ ሃገራት ከም ሃንጋሪ፣ ቱርኪ፣ ማሌዥያ፣ ሩስያን ህንድን ሰፊሕ ውጽኢት ይቕበላ።
  • ሓያል ውጽኢት እንግሊዝኛን ንጹር ደብዳቤ ድሌትን ትሑት GPA ክመጣጠኑ ይኽእሉ።
  • ንካልኣይ ዲግሪ ተመኩሮ ስራሕ ይቑጸር፤ ገለ ስኮላርሺፓት ከም DAAD EPOS የድልይዎ።
Will my degree be recognised in Ethiopia?
ዲግሪዬ በኢትዮጵያ እውቅና ያገኛል?
Digriin koo Itoophiyaatti beekamtii argataa?
ዲግሪየይ ኣብ ኢትዮጵያ ኣፍልጦ ክረክብ ድዩ?

We only shortlist accredited, government-recognised universities, which is the first condition for recognition at home.

When you return, foreign degrees are evaluated by Ethiopia's Education and Training Authority. Keep your original certificates, transcripts and proof of study. Online-only or very short programs can be harder to recognise, so we check this before you apply.

የምንመርጠው እውቅና ያላቸውንና በመንግስት የተረጋገጡ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎችን ብቻ ነው፤ ይህም በሀገር ቤት እውቅና ለማግኘት የመጀመሪያው ቅድመ ሁኔታ ነው።

ሲመለሱ የውጭ ዲግሪዎች በኢትዮጵያ የትምህርትና ስልጠና ባለስልጣን ይገመገማሉ። ዋና ሰርተፊኬቶችዎን፣ ትራንስክሪፕቶችዎንና የትምህርት ማረጋገጫዎን ይያዙ። በኦንላይን ብቻ ወይም በጣም አጭር የሆኑ ፕሮግራሞች እውቅና ለማግኘት ሊከብዱ ስለሚችሉ ከማመልከትዎ በፊት እናረጋግጣለን።

Yuunivarsiitiiwwan beekamtii qabanii fi mootummaan mirkanaa'an qofa filanna; kunis biyya keessatti beekamtii argachuuf ulaagaa jalqabaa ti.

Yeroo deebitu, digriiwwan biyya alaa Abbaa Taayitaa Barnootaa fi Leenjii Itoophiyaatiin madaalamu. Ragaalee, traanskiriptii fi ragaa barnootaa kee isa jalqabaa qabadhu. Sagantaaleen toora interneetii qofa ykn baay'ee gabaabaa ta'an beekamtii argachuuf ulfaachuu waan danda'aniif osoo hin iyyatin dura ni mirkaneessina.

ኣፍልጦ ዘለዎምን ብመንግስቲ ዝተረጋገጹን ዩኒቨርሲቲታት ጥራይ ኢና ንመርጽ፤ እዚ ድማ ኣብ ሃገር ኣፍልጦ ንምርካብ ቀዳማይ ቅድመ ኩነት እዩ።

MINISTRY OF EDUCATION AND CULTURE — STUDY IN FINLAND 2026/2027
Official International Student Prospectus & Destination Guide
================================================================================

1. DESTINATION OVERVIEW & ACADEMIC REPUTATION
Finland consistently ranks as the happiest country in the world and boasts one of the most innovative, world-renowned education systems. Finnish universities offer over 500 English-taught bachelor’s and master’s degree programmes. Renowned for world-class research in technology, sustainability, clean energy, and education, Finland provides international students with a safe, transparent, and high-tech living environment.

2. TUITION FEES & FINANCIAL PLANNING
- Non-EU/EEA Tuition Fees: Typically range from €8,000 to €15,000 per academic year depending on the university and degree level.
- University Scholarships: Most Finnish universities offer merit-based tuition waivers (50% to 100% discount) to high-achieving non-EU applicants upon admission.
- Estimated Cost of Living: Approximately €700 to €1,000 per month depending on the city (Helsinki and Espoo average €900–1,100/mo, while student cities like Tampere, Oulu, and Turku average €700–850/mo). Costs cover student housing, food, local transport, and utilities.

3. STUDENT WORK RIGHTS & EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITIES
- Part-Time Work Rights During Studies: International degree students hold residence permits allowing up to 30 hours per week of employment during the academic terms, and unlimited hours during summer and winter breaks.
- Post-Graduation Work Permit (Extended Residence Permit): Upon graduation, international graduates are eligible for a 2-year post-study residence permit to seek employment or start an innovative business in Finland.

4. ADMISSION INTAKES & REQUIREMENTS
- Primary Intake: Autumn Intake (classes commence late August / early September). Joint application window is open in January each year.
- Secondary Intake: Spring Intake (available for select universities of applied sciences; classes commence in January).
- English Proficiency Requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 (minimum 5.5 in each section), TOEFL iBT 92+, PTE Academic 62, or C1 Advanced. Some universities accept Duolingo English Test (115+).
- Key Study Fields: Information Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Business Administration, Environmental Sciences, Renewable Energy, and Nursing.

5. TOP UNIVERSITIES IN FINLAND
- University of Helsinki
- Aalto University
- Tampere University
- University of Turku
- Oulu University of Applied Sciences (Oamk)
- LAB University of Applied Sciences

6. STUDENT RESIDENCE PERMIT (VISA) PROCESS & REQUIREMENTS
- Processing Duration: 4 to 8 weeks via the Enter Finland electronic portal.
- Financial Requirement: Proof of funds amounting to €6,720 per year (€560 per month) deposited in a personal bank account under the student's name.
- Mandatory Private Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance valid for the full study duration (minimum €40,000 to €120,000 coverage).
- Application Steps:
  1. Receive official letter of acceptance from Finnish university.
  2. Pay the tuition fee deposit (or receive scholarship waiver confirmation).
  3. Submit online application on the Enter Finland portal.
  4. Book biometric verification appointment at the Embassy of Finland in Addis Ababa.
  5. Receive residence permit biometric card before travel.

7. EXPERT ADVISOR TIPS FOR ETHIOPIAN APPLICANTS
Finnish Universities of Applied Sciences (UAS) frequently participate in the joint International UAS Exam. Candidates can take this written entrance exam online from Addis Ababa without traveling. Scoring in the top percentile grants direct admission and an automatic 50% tuition scholarship.

GOVERNMENT OF HUNGARY: STIPENDIUM HUNGARICUM SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAMME 2026/2027
Official Call for Applications — International Higher Education Studies in Hungary
================================================================================

1. PROGRAMME OVERVIEW
The Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme was launched in 2013 by the Hungarian Government. The core mission of the programme is to increase the number of international students in Hungary and encourage Hungarian higher education institutions to attract top international talent. Today, thousands of international students from over 90 partner countries, including Ethiopia, pursue higher education in Hungary annually.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & APPLICANT PROFILE
Eligible applicants must satisfy the following conditions:
- Citizenship: Citizen of an eligible partner country (Ethiopian nationals are fully eligible through bilateral educational agreements).
- Degree Levels Offered: Bachelor (BA/BSc), Master (MA/MSc), and Doctoral (PhD) degree programs.
- Minimum Academic Qualifications:
  * For Bachelor studies: High school graduation certificate with minimum 75% average (or Ethiopian University Entrance Exam completion with distinction).
  * For Master studies: Bachelor degree with minimum CGPA of 3.0 / 4.0.
  * For Doctoral studies: Master degree with strong research proposal and supervisor pre-approval.
- Language Proficiency: B2/C1 English level. Accepted tests: IELTS 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 72+, or Duolingo English Test 105+.
- Age Limit: Applicants must have reached 18 years of age by August 31, 2026.

3. SCHOLARSHIP COVERAGE & FINANCIAL PROVISIONS
The scholarship provides full funding throughout the entire duration of studies:
- Tuition Fees: 100% full tuition waiver across all participating Hungarian state universities.
- Monthly Living Stipend: HUF 43,700 (approx. €120–140) per month for Bachelor and Master; HUF 140,000 for PhD.
- Accommodation Support: Free dormitory placement on university campus OR monthly housing allowance of HUF 40,000.
- Medical Insurance: Full national health insurance services according to Hungarian law, plus supplementary private health insurance up to HUF 65,000 per year.
- Round-trip flight ticket is covered by the Ethiopian Ministry of Education for nominated candidates.

4. APPLICATION WINDOW & DEADLINES
- Application System Opens: November 15, 2025
- Application Deadline: January 15, 2026 (2:00 PM Central European Time)
- Academic Year Commences: September 2026

5. POPULAR FIELDS OF STUDY
- Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence
- Mechanical, Civil, and Electrical Engineering
- Agricultural Sciences & Water Management
- International Relations & Economics

6. STRATEGIC ADVISOR NOTE FOR ETHIOPIAN APPLICANTS
This is a dual-application process. Candidates must submit an application on the official DreamApply portal and must also submit a nomination dossier to the Ethiopian Ministry of Education (FDRE MoE). Applying to regional universities with specialized engineering faculties (such as University of Debrecen, University of Szeged, or University of Pécs) yields a significantly higher acceptance rate compared to institutions solely located in central Budapest.

7. OFFICIAL APPLICATION PORTAL
Official Portal URL: https://apply.stipendiumhungaricum.hu
Managing Authority: Tempus Public Foundation, Budapest, Hungary
